governingRule: Official government sites only. Each topic answers to whoever owns that topic: township questions to the township, license and placard questions to the NJ MVC, county road and park questions to Hudson County. No blogs, news articles, forums or search snippets treated as fact. If no listed source covers a question, fall back to the Help Desk instead of answering from model memory.

notApproved.note: PSE&G is the authority for its own outage reporting, but it is NOT an approved source for this chatbot. Discussion only.

policy: Adding a source takes a deliberate admin edit and, in production, Clerk approval. The chatbot may only search, fetch and cite sources on this list.
ranking: For local facts, township sources outrank county sources, which outrank state sources.

sources.scope: Township government: departments, meetings, calendar, news, forms
North Bergen School District, school questions only
North Bergen Free Public Library, library hours and programs only
North Bergen Parking Authority: resident parking permits, overnight parking rules, meters and parking enforcement. Added by Nick's direction on 2026-11-21.
North Bergen Police Department: police non-emergency information, Traffic Bureau, traffic safety and abandoned vehicle reporting. Added by Nick's direction on 2026-11-24.
North Bergen Municipal Utilities Authority: sewer service and billing, garbage and recycling collection. Added by Nick's direction on 2026-11-24.
County roads, county parks including Braddock Park, elections, county services
NJ Motor Vehicle Commission: plates, disability placards, licenses
NJ court system: tickets and municipal court process
State programs that township pages point to
